newsitem.title: USA: Clinton names Arkansas pal as Veterans' Secretary.
newsitem.headline: Clinton names Arkansas pal as Veterans' Secretary.

text.p: President Bill Clinton said Thursday he would nominate deputy Secretary of Veterans' Affairs Hershel Gober to head the department, replacing Jesse Brown who resigned on July 1.

"I intend to nominate deputy Secretary Gober to be the next Secretary of Veterans' Affairs," Clinton said at a White House ceremony at which veterans' organisations pledged their support for the expansion of NATO.

Gober, a two-tour veteran of the Vietnam War whose 20-year military career included service in both the army and marines, was director of the Arkansas Department of Veterans' Affairs when Clinton was the state governor.

As the number two man at the federal agency for veterans, he has actively pressed for expansion of benefits to Vietnam veterans exposed to the defoliant Agent Orange and Gulf War veterans who suffer from undiagnosed illness.
If confirmed by the Senate, Gober will be responsible for maintaining a nationwide network of resources and services for America's 26 million military veterans.
Brown, who has held that job for the last five years, resigned on Monday to return to private life.
